The result is a self-purifying economy: every epoch, low-cost fake identities are filtered out by the same reputation mechanics that reward the honest ones.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a pearl as the anchor of the cost.
